proposals.before: On guihai, former Yanzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became commissioner of Xuzhou, and Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and defender of the Western Capital.
proposals.after: On guihai, former Yunzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became commissioner of Xuzhou (Xu), and Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and defender of the Western Capital.
proposals.reason: Chinese day is guihai (癸亥), not gengshen; Yunzhou (鄆州) was mistranslated as Yanzhou.

proposals.before: On day guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military commissioner of Xuzhou; Gao Xingzhou, former defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Henan and defender of the Western Capital.
proposals.after: On day guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military commissioner of Yunzhou, was made military commissioner of Xuzhou (Xu); Gao Xingzhou, former defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Henan and defender of the Western Capital.
proposals.reason: Yunzhou (鄆州) was mistranslated as Yanzhou in the literal English.

proposals.before: Former Cangzhou was redesignated the Deqing army.
proposals.after: Former Chanzhou was redesignated the Deqing army.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cangzhou (滄州).

proposals.before: The former Cangzhou was renamed the Deqing army.
proposals.after: The former Chanzhou was renamed the Deqing army.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cangzhou.

proposals.before: On the new moon of the tenth winter month, Ceremonial Vice Minister Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Cang to inspect flood damage to the crops.
proposals.after: On the new moon of the tenth winter month, Ceremonial Vice Minister Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yun, and Chan to inspect flood damage to the crops.
proposals.reason: 澶 was rendered Cang; it is Chan/Chanzhou (澶州), and 鄆 is Yun, not Yan.

proposals.before: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Secretariat Chancellor Zhang Congen as overseer.
proposals.after: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Bureau attendant Zhang Cong'en as overseer.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張從恩 is Zhang Cong'en; packet English omits the apostrophe as Congen, and 宣徽南院使 is Palace Bureau attendant not Secretariat Chancellor.

proposals.before: Chongyi, former acting Eastern Capital defender and Henan prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;
proposals.after: Chong'ai (Chongyi), former acting Eastern Capital defender and Henan prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;
proposals.reason: Chinese 重乂 (Chongyi/Chong'ai) was collapsed with 重裔 as identical English Chongyi; keep distinct given names.

proposals.before: Chongyi, former Imperial City vice commissioner and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;
proposals.after: Chongyi (裔), former Imperial City vice commissioner and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;
proposals.reason: Distinguish 重裔 from 重乂; both were rendered Chongyi.

proposals.before: Yanzhou commissioner, northern campaign commander, and Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo commissioner at Hengzhou and was also made Vice Grand Councilor;
proposals.after: Yunzhou commissioner, northern campaign commander, and Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo commissioner at Hengzhou and was also made Vice Grand Councilor;
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou (兗州).

proposals.before: Heyang commissioner and Palace Guard chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yanzhou commissioner, and kept his army command.
proposals.after: Heyang commissioner and Palace Guard chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yunzhou commissioner, and kept his army command.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou (兗州/延州).

proposals.before: On bingwu, an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and E have much unused land. Households may reclaim it as they choose, with labor and tax levies waived for five years."
proposals.after: On bingwu, an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying have much unused land. Households may reclaim it as they choose, with labor and tax levies waived for five years."
proposals.reason: 郢州 is Ying, not E.

proposals.before: An edict granted the Hushan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."
proposals.after: An edict granted the Liaoshan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."
proposals.reason: 蓼山 is Liaoshan/Mount Liao; Hushan is a mistranslation of 蓼.

proposals.before: On bingxu in the intercalary month, War Bureau Director Si Tuyi became Right Remonstrance Censor.
proposals.after: On bingxu in the intercalary month, War Bureau Director Situ Xu became Right Remonstrance Censor.
proposals.reason: 司徒詡 has the compound surname Situ; Si Tuyi splits it incorrectly.

proposals.before: An edict renamed the Xuandu Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;
proposals.after: An edict renamed the Yedu Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;
proposals.reason: 鄴都宣明門 is the Xuaming Gate at Yedu, not Xuandu.

proposals.before: That spring drought struck Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, and Chen, while locusts ravaged Yan, Cao, Dan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming.
proposals.after: That spring drought struck Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, and Chen, while locusts ravaged Yun, Cao, Chan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming.
proposals.reason: 鄆 is Yun not Yan; 澶 is Chan/Dan confusion—prefer Chan for 澶州.

proposals.before: In the sixth month, on dingsi, Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan became Jinchang army commissioner, and former Xuzhou commissioner An Shenqi became Yanzhou commissioner.
proposals.after: In the sixth month, on dingsi, Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan became Jinchang army commissioner, and former Xuzhou (Xu) commissioner An Shenqi became Yanzhou commissioner.
proposals.reason: 許州 is Xu prefecture (Xuzhou/Xu); unmarked Xuzhou risks confusion with 徐州.
